name: ascending
sql: SELECT TOP (3) id, score FROM leafkit_translate ORDER BY id

name: descending-filter
sql: SELECT TOP (2) [r].[id], [r].[score] FROM [leafkit_translate] AS [r] WHERE [r].[id] > 1 ORDER BY [r].[id] DESC
target: SELECT "r"."id", "r"."score" FROM "leafkit_translate" AS "r" WHERE "r"."id" > 1 ORDER BY "r"."id" DESC LIMIT 2

name: zero
sql: SELECT TOP (0) id, score FROM leafkit_translate ORDER BY id

name: over-cardinality
sql: SELECT TOP (9223372036854775807) id, score FROM leafkit_translate ORDER BY id

name: qualified-shadow-control
sql: SELECT TOP (2) id AS original_id, score AS id FROM leafkit_translate ORDER BY leafkit_translate.id
target: SELECT "id" AS "original_id", "score" AS "id" FROM "leafkit_translate" ORDER BY "leafkit_translate"."id" LIMIT 2

name: proven-key-alias
sql: SELECT TOP (2) id AS id, score FROM leafkit_translate ORDER BY id
target: SELECT "id" AS "id", "score" FROM "leafkit_translate" ORDER BY "id" LIMIT 2

name: native-star
sql: SELECT TOP (3) * FROM leafkit_translate ORDER BY id
